policy.description: The policy file, relative to this settings file

env.description: The environment variable holding the Personal Access Token

command.description: A command whose standard output is the token (a secret manager's CLI, for example); honored from user and managed settings only

file.description: A file holding the token on its first line; relative to the settings file. Without it, the project's .asana-gate/token and then ~/.asana-gate/token are tried
A file log lines are appended to besides stderr, relative to the settings file (default: ~/.asana-gate/logs/asana-gate.log); null for none

enabled.description: Whether the names and gids of the workspace's structure are cached on disk between runs

dir.description: Where the cache lives; relative to the settings file

ttl.description: How long a cached listing is trusted before it is read again

writes.description: Concurrent POST, PUT and DELETE requests (Asana allows 15)

max.description: Retries after a 429, or after a 5xx for anything but a POST

maxWait.description: The longest wait before a retry; a longer Retry-After is cut to it

enable.description: Flags sent in the Asana-Enable header of every request: an early-access opt-in such as ai_teammate_actors (the Agents endpoints), or an announced change taken before its date

disable.description: Flags sent in the Asana-Disable header of every request: an announced change kept off while Asana still allows it

allowedHosts.description: Extra host names accepted in Host and Origin headers

authTokenEnv.description: The environment variable with the bearer token HTTP clients must present

title: asana-gate settings
description: One layer of asana-gate settings (user, project, project-local or managed); every member is optional and layers are merged.
